content.comment_body: Hello. Is anyone using the ISWvis mobile app to control [company_name] [product_name] or a similar device? Is it reliable and consistent? I tried the demo version for a short period, and it worked well, but I plan to use it in the future to control the air suspension system in my vehicle, so I want to ensure it works as expected. Also, how can I use the text list to send a specific value to the PLC using a pushbutton?
Hello, ISW is an established software company that sells commercial software. For this reason, their app should work properly.

Hello everyone, Has anyone purchased the full version of the ISWvis mobile app? How does the licensing work if you need to transfer your license from a stolen phone to a new device? Is it possible for the company to release the MAC address and provide a new license? I attempted to contact them directly by email but only received an automated reply in German.
Hello [user_name], I think it is best to keep trying to reach out to ISW for further assistance. Hopefully, you will get a useful response. Best of luck, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The conversation revolves around the usage of a third-party mobile HMI app for controlling a [company_name] [product_name] device. Participants are assessing its reliability, user-friendliness, and consistency. Questions are raised about long-term performance and how licensing can be managed when a device change or loss occurs. Comments reference [company_name] products in relation to compatibility rather than direct functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the app-based control system to operate consistently and reliably with third-party software, offering an easy method for sending value commands to the PLC and transparent, flexible licensing that supports device changes.
